novelty_flags.label: thm:witness-separation / thm:open-neighborhood-separation
novelty_flags.one_line: The negative comparison refutes only the proposal's internally invented Gω probe, while its consumer expressly says no cited clinical workflow uses or recommends Gω; name and faithfully instantiate a published variance-design criterion or demote these witness results to an internal diagnostic.

soundness_flags.label: thm:finite-menu-higbee-contrast
soundness_flags.one_line: “Local representation preserving the three labeled choices” and Higbee’s maintained condition are not defined in the core, so the claimed non-representability is not a mathematically testable statement; define the comparator class and state the tie-to-nonuniqueness implication directly.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:deterministic-rate-limit and thm:local-minimax-lower-bound
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Optimality is only against procedures whose pilot-selected main-wave rates converge to one deterministic feasible design; fully sequential acquisition, positive-fraction pilots, and random limiting designs are excluded.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline local-minimax equality is conditional on the comparison class 𝔄_det, not an optimality claim over all adaptive annotation procedures.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace Gω with a named published multidimensional sampling criterion—such as Wang, Wang, and Miao’s componentwise maximin-efficiency rule—and prove a strict design/regret separation, or clearly demote Gω to a computational diagnostic rather than a novelty theorem.

Define an explicit comparator condition extracted from Higbee’s local strong-concavity framework and prove that the three-way tie violates its unique-optimum consequence; remove the undefined representation language.

Add a clearly scoped static-versus-sequential frontier: either prove an overlapping-policy obstruction to importing independent-arm sequential allocation, or state an OEQ seeking a strict sequential improvement over V* under the same observation geometry.

recommended_next_step: Revise the Higbee comparison into a defined noncoverage proposition and anchor or demote the internal-Gω separation; retain the deterministic-limit scope explicitly, then advance the repaired field-tier core to Stage 0.
